title: Ukulele
coreMove: Build a tiny performance subset until it can survive real ears, not just private hope.
sourcePressure: The source frames ukulele through deliberate narrowing, isolated repetition, and a small public-performance standard rather than total instrumental breadth.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating narrowing as making the standard private and easy, when the source points toward a small subset tested by public performance readiness.

sourceAnchors.name: ukulele
sourceAnchors.detail: the frozen support names ukulele as the case and frames it through isolated repetition, deliberate narrowing, and public performance readiness
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The ukulele case is not about becoming broad; it is about making a small sound reliable enough for someone else to hear.

sourceAnchors.name: public performance readiness
sourceAnchors.detail: the source supports public performance readiness as the narrow target that tests whether the isolated repetitions hold
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: A living-room chord is not the same thing as a chord that survives another person listening.

exampleSpecs.domain: wedding toast speaker learning one short harmonica phrase
exampleSpecs.audience: a reader narrowing a performance goal for real listeners
exampleSpecs.stakes: the phrase must land cleanly before her sister's toast, not become a musicianship project
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Olivia reduces the target to eight bars, isolates the breath change, records three takes, and plays it once for the best man before adding flair
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a silver harmonica resting on a folded toast card

exampleSpecs.domain: museum educator learning a short puppet manipulation sequence
exampleSpecs.audience: a performer who needs one reliable public-ready slice
exampleSpecs.stakes: a school group will lose the exhibit story if the puppet collapses mid-demonstration

exampleSpecs.domain: amateur magician preparing one coin vanish for a family party

exampleSpecs.domain: community radio producer learning one live sound-bed fade

skillTargets: define a narrow public-ready performance subset
distinguish private comfort from listener-tested readiness
choose isolated repetition that stabilizes the key movement
avoid turning narrowing into a low standard
